posts.long:
Hello! We're Kaotic Chainz 🔗

Two small Android apps are on the way. StackUp shows what's safe to spend before payday. LoopDay is a habit tracker that forgives a missed day.

Google asks for real testers before a new app can go public, so every one helps. Join at kaoticchainz.com/testers

#StackUp #LoopDay #androidapp

posts.short:
Can you afford it before payday? StackUp works out what's safe to spend from your pay dates and bills. No bank login.

Help test it: kaoticchainz.com/testers
posts.long:
Ran out of money before payday? StackUp shows what's safe to spend today, this week and until payday. No bank login, and your numbers stay on your phone. General budgeting tools only. Help test it: kaoticchainz.com/testers

#StackUp #paydayhelp #budgeting
